meta.name: info-funnel
meta.description: 3-6 阶递减漏斗, 突出转化率 / 筛选比例 / 流量损耗。竖图适合 IG Story / 小红书

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作转化漏斗图，突出流量损耗与筛选比例
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在社交媒体上展示营销漏斗数据
copy.tagline_en: Create conversion funnel charts highlighting traffic loss and filter ratios
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to present marketing funnel data on social media

howto.what: 当你想把“从多到少”的转化过程看清楚时，它会生成一张竖版漏斗图：宽顶窄底，每一阶段显示剩余数字和转化率，底部给出累计转化率和流失最大的环节。输出为单个网页文件，可直接打开。
howto.when: 当你要求制作漏斗图，或描述转化、筛选、流失等“由大到小”的阶段数据（3-6 阶）时触发。

say.text: 来个招聘漏斗：投递 5000、面试 800、录用 120、入职 90
say.note: 输出 9:16 竖版漏斗，底部显示累计转化率。

say.text: 用deep-forest主题画教育漏斗：咨询2000→试听600→报名150
say.note: 按深绿色主题生成，适合教育场景。

howto.what_en: Given a decreasing sequence, it generates a vertical funnel infographic in a single HTML file: wide top, narrow bottom, each stage shows value and conversion rate, bottom strip shows cumulative rate and biggest drop-off.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a funnel chart or describe a 3–6 stage conversion/screening/drop-off process with stage values.

say_en.text: Make a 5-step funnel from visitors to paid: 100k → 18.5k → 6.2k → 1.45k → 920.
say_en.note: Generates a vertical funnel HTML with step conversion rates.

say_en.text: Recruiting funnel: 5000 applied → 800 interviewed → 120 hired → 90 onboarded.
say_en.note: 9:16 vertical funnel, cumulative conversion at bottom.
Uses the deep-forest palette for the funnel.
